title: Fishing Nets
description: A more ethical way to collect fish.
body:
# Fishing Nets

This project is still under development, compatibility with new verisons, old versions, and multiplayer is not guaranteed. Currently, this project only officially supports 1.21.3.

### Additions
- Adds a Fishing Net to the game.
    - Right Click a Fish (Cod, Salmon, Tropical Fish, and Pufferfish) to collect it.
    - 59 durability. Missed catches will use up 1 durability. Succesful catches uses up 3.
    - Crafted with 6 string and 1 stick, arranged like a sign.

### Purpose
> Killing Fish always seemed a little bit cruel. Now, you can simply pick up a fish! No murder required!


### The Resource Pack is required!
**For Singleplayer:**
> Install the resource pack as you would any other resource pack.

**For Multiplayer:**
> Please send the resource pack to every member of a multiplayer server to be enabled whilst playing with this datapack, or configure the server in such a way to automatically download the resource pack. There are many tutorials online.
